expectations.text: Uses a valid cub authentication check (cub context get or cub space list), NOT cub info
expectations.evidence: Baseline used `cub info` as an auth check — flagged invalid per user correction.

expectations.text: Checks the Worker is Ready before binding Units to the Target
expectations.evidence: No `cub worker get` or `cub worker status` call.

expectations.text: Inspects the existing Target before binding, confirming provider/toolchain and worker
Uses cub unit set-target (not cub unit update --target or a cub target create for an already-existing Target)
expectations.evidence: Baseline proposed `cub unit update --target` which is not the correct verb; the correct verb is `cub unit set-target`.

expectations.text: Does NOT pass --change-desc on cub unit set-target
expectations.evidence: Baseline invented `--change-description` (wrong flag name) on the binding step, violating the rule that target binding is not a config-data mutation.

expectations.text: Verifies binding via cub unit get (TargetID) and the TargetID IS NOT NULL where-clause
expectations.evidence: Baseline verifies with kubectl + cub unit get but does not use the TargetID IS NOT NULL where-clause.

expectations.text: Stops short of apply, hands off to cub-apply
expectations.evidence: Baseline plans to run `cub unit apply` in the same flow — does not respect the skill boundary.
